The Process

How Do I Book with an Auto Transport Company?

MAB PK Management Corp's guide to quick, easy, and safe auto shipping.

Step 1

Quote and Book Your Order

Use our free instant quote calculator to get an estimate or call (315) 281-9742. When ready to book, a representative will review your shipment and confirm your order.

Step 2

We Pick Up Your Vehicle

Schedule your pickup with your trucker. A fully vetted carrier arrives, inspects your vehicle, documents its condition, and loads it securely.

Step 3

Receive Your Vehicle

Your trucker calls when near your delivery location. You inspect together, sign off, and your vehicle is home. It's that simple.

2026 Guide

How Much Do Car Transport Companies Charge?

Car shipping costs are based on distance, vehicle size, transport type, season, and market conditions. Our TruePrice Guarantee protects you from unexpected increases.

DistanceOpen TransportEnclosed TransportExample Route
1–500 miles$1.85 / mile$2.53 / milePittsburgh → Boston: $729
500–1,500 miles$0.91 / mile$1.25 / mileHouston → Los Angeles: $859
1,500+ miles$0.59 / mile$0.84 / mileBuffalo → Seattle: $1,679

Vehicle type adjustment: Add ~$150–$250 for SUVs and trucks vs. sedan. Get an exact quote or call (315) 281-9742.

What We Offer

Popular Vehicle Shipping Services

Door-to-Door Car Shipping

We pick up and deliver as close to your addresses as legally and safely possible. The driver comes right to you — residential, commercial, or dealership.

Open Auto Transport

The most cost-effective option. Your vehicle travels on an open carrier — standard industry method used by dealerships nationwide. Affordable and reliable.

Enclosed Auto Transport

Maximum protection from weather and road debris. Ideal for luxury, classic, exotic, or high-value vehicles. Fully enclosed trailer for complete peace of mind.

Expedited Auto Transport

Guaranteed pickup date. Your vehicle gets priority scheduling for the fastest possible transit. Available for time-sensitive shipments.

Cross-Country Shipping

Coast-to-coast transport with full tracking. We ship across all 48 contiguous states with reliable timing and competitive pricing on long-distance routes.

Fleet & Commercial

Multi-vehicle transport for dealerships, auctions, rental agencies, and corporate fleets. Volume discounts and dedicated account management available.
